metadata.question: Are there active fires in October 24, 2023 in Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products for October 24, 2023 - FIRMS dataset: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MOD14A1" for daily fire detections - Alternative: VIIRS "FIRMS" data - Location: Canada boundary - Date: October 24, 2023 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed - we're looking FOR fires - Check fire mask band or confidence values - Count fire pixels directly 3. Logic: - Valid Zero (B): Collection exists, pixels exist, but no fires detected (FireMask = 0) - C1: No images available for that date - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid - A: Fires detected (FireMask > 0 or confidence > threshold) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Canada geometry and date const canada = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Canada')); const canadaGeom = canada.geometry(); const targetDate = '2023-10-24'; // 2. Try MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire product let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(targetDate, '2023-10-25') .filterBounds(canadaGeom); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS fire images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try VIIRS as fallback fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') .filterDate(targetDate, '2023-10-25') .filterBounds(canadaGeom); const fallbackSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback MYD14A1 images found: ${fallbackSize}`); if (fallbackSize === 0) { console.log('No fire detection data available for Oct 24, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Get fire mask band and count fire pixels const fireImage = fireCollection.first(); const fireMask = fireImage.select('FireMask'); // Count total pixels const pixelCount = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canadaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Count fire pixels (FireMask values 7-9 indicate fires) const firePixels = fireMask.gte(7); const fireCount = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canadaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire pixels detected: ${fireCount}`); // 5. Validation and final answer if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (fireCount > 0) { console.log(`Active fires confirmed in Canada on Oct 24, 2023`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No active fires detected in Canada on Oct 24, 2023'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
